summary: macOS 13+ full-display ScreenCaptureKit now applies the selected screen profile as a maximum long-edge resolution while preserving the display aspect ratio and selected frame rate. The macOS release bundle builds and passes local code-signature integrity checks. Actual share/viewer runtime, window capture, and pre-macOS-13 fallback remain open.

checks.name: Profile constraints reach ScreenCaptureKit
checks.observation: The Flutter profile supplies width/height plus desktop mandatory frameRate. FlutterRTCDesktopCapturer extracts the requested long-edge ceiling and passes it to FlutterScreenCaptureKitCapturer. ScreenCaptureKit bounds its configured output dimensions by min(1, profileLongEdge/sourceLongEdge), preserves source aspect ratio, and rounds both dimensions down to even pixel sizes. This applies to the macOS 13+ full-display ScreenCaptureKit branch only.

checks.name: macOS release build
checks.observation: Built BOOHTACORD.app (92.4 MB) from 28a8645aafc0b1f43520e86fe7e0eda36bff4b15. Xcode emitted its existing ld address/target-atom warning; build succeeded.

checks.name: macOS bundle signature integrity
checks.observation: The app bundle and nested frameworks are valid on disk and satisfy their designated requirements. This does not constitute Developer ID notarization.

checks.name: Physical capture and receiver acceptance
checks.observation: No live screen-share run was performed. Source enumeration, user consent, frame edge/aspect preservation, actual sender dimensions/FPS, window capture, and macOS 12 fallback still need device/runtime verification.

remaining: Run 720/1080/1440p full-display profiles with a macOS 13+ sender and remote web/Flutter viewers, confirm all four edges and source aspect through resize/fullscreen, then implement and verify matching caps for window capture, the macOS 12 fallback, and Windows.
